title: render record
description: Everything one render depends on, so a consumer can cite it and analyze the audio with the same notes. Times are in seconds, the tempo in beats per minute.

arch.description: The architecture of the host process, such as x86_64.

recipe_version.description: The version of the render recipe; any change to the recipe raises it.

settle.description: The silence rendered after the state load.

oversampling.description: The oversampling of a Vital render.

last_note_off.description: The end of the last note.

tail_capped.description: Whether the tail reached its cap before it went quiet.

midi_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the MIDI file the notes came from. Absent for notes that came from no file.

load_check.description: The load check of the render, when it ran: the octave-band distance of the clip from the plug-in's init patch, the distance between two init renders, and the margin the first had to exceed. All in dB.
